display_long_description:
Prologue Ed.GorgeousGhost
Wander Through 《Strange Tales》
Core Experience
Step into a VR realm from 《Strange Tales》   —where mortal and spirit worlds blend like mist.     The 86-minute story unfolds in first person: from the soft bashfulness of your first meeting with Nie Xiaoqian at Lanruo Temple, to the bond forged as you stand through shared perils.     By candlelight that dances on stone walls and wind chimes that hum like whispers, you’ll reach out and hold this tender legend that bridges life and the afterlife.
Thoughtful Design for Seamless Resuming
No need to fear VR fatigue or sudden device shutdowns—the auto-save function locks in your exit point, as if pausing a dream.     After lifting the quest to rest, you’ll slip right back into the moment: mid-conversation, or just before the scene shifts to misty corridors or moonlit shores.     Let the 86-minute tale unfold at a pace that feels like your own.
Immersive Details Recreating Classics
Scene Restoration: Withered vines coiling around the temple’s weathered walls, a lakeside pavilion draped in moonlight (with fireflies flickering nearby), and window lattices carved with delicate bamboo patterns—all echo the lyrical aesthetics of classic films.
Character Depth: Nie Xiaoqian’s bright wit and ethereal grace (her robes soft as cloud), Ning Caichen’s gentle naivety and unwavering integrity—every detail captures the "ghost maiden of old memories," paying heartfelt homage to the Hong Kong classic A Chinese Ghost Story.
